_about: 2-Butanol (1) + Water (2): total pressures against temperature, 523-573 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 2-butanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: Y. Shimoyama, Y. Iwai, K. Yamada, M. Yamakita, Y. Arai, Measurement and Correlation of Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Water + 2-Propanol, Water + 2-Butanol, and Water + 2-Pentanol Systems at High Temperatures and Pressures, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51 (2006) 51-55
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
